digest.component_or_area: completion verification and close artifacts publication
propositions: Completion verification currently materializes full Git-backed ticket store despite reading only a small subset, incurring 135-235 seconds of close trace time.
Close path publishes PASS COMPLETION_VERDICT, STATUS transition, and completion SIGNATURE through separate writes, creating durability gaps where sidecar or status can outlive failures.
Pinned ticket view must resolve arbitrary IDs/aliases/Jira bindings at tickets_oid without fallback to live state or internal caching, recording negative reads.
Close transaction must atomically commit PASS sidecar, closed STATUS, and completion SIGNATURE in one Git commit, or roll back all three with no partial artifacts left behind.
Receipt validation must detect non-ancestor history, relevant path diffs, and predicate conflicts; unrelated changes may proceed after revalidation without force or remote rejection.
